items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I’m not sure Sandy McEwen was very proud, you know Sandy who didn’t allow no jazz on Sunday

ctx.x: The High Street Five from Wesleyan. There are a handful of them but the Catatonic Five was highly rated. The fact that we played at Carnegie Hall in ’56, and toured Europe that same year, so I thought it actually reflected very favorably on the college. Here’s this little tiny college that’s got the best Dixieland — one of the best Dixieland bands in the country, and was getting a lot of press. And I think we were proud of that and frankly, I’m not sure Sandy McEwen was very proud, you know Sandy who didn’t allow…
Oh you can’t just gloss over that you have to tell me about that.
